stem.text: Compound $M$ is an important ingredient in perfume.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of compound M: a cyclopentanone ring with the C=O at the top; the ring carbon next to the C=O bears a pentyl chain, and the next ring carbon bears a CH2CO2CH3 (methyl ester) group.
stem.label: compound M

stem.text: Which statements about this reaction are correct?

items: A small amount of NaOH will speed up the reaction.
The reaction is initiated by the transfer of a proton to one of the $\text{C=O}$ groups.
Both of the $\text{C=O}$ groups react with $\text{HCN}$.
